title: Manufacturer Quarterly Fleet Program Cash
content:
**Program cash notice, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

The manufacturer's quarterly fleet program adds program cash to a unit's fleet incentive. The amount depends on the calendar quarter in which the unit's delivery date falls.

| Month of the unit's delivery date | Program cash |
|---|---|
| July, August or September | USD 500.00 |
| April, May or June | USD 250.00 |
| January, February, March, October, November or December | none |

## Clause

A unit delivered in July, August or September earns program cash of 500.00. A unit delivered in April, May or June earns 250.00. A unit delivered in any other month earns no program cash.

## Points of judgement

- **The date that counts is the unit's delivery date.** The contract date does not count, and neither does the date the incentive is credited.
- **Quarter edges.** A unit delivered on the last day of June earns 250.00. A unit delivered on the first day of July earns 500.00. A unit delivered on the last day of September earns 500.00. A unit delivered on the first day of October earns none.
- **Hypothetical case.** Two units from the same hypothetical order are delivered on 30 March and 2 April of one year. The March unit earns no program cash, and the April unit earns 250.00.
